summary: Frontend-only verification of Share/Print (CSV/PDF/Print) exports on /manage/report and /expenses plus new calendar-based Custom Date Range on Reports. Logged in as admin@glowup.com. All acceptance criteria pass: share buttons visible, bottom sheets render 3 options each, CSV downloads on web with correct filename & header/TOTAL rows, PDF opens a new window (popup), and the react-native-calendars period picker responds to day taps (first tap sets FROM and auto-advances to TO, second tap sets TO, Apply Range refreshes report and closes modal). No regressions observed on report/expenses list rendering. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the touched files (expo-print, expo-sharing, expo-file-system v19 File API, react-native-calendars are all current).
critical_code_review_comments: PDF popup content assertion via Playwright is timing-sensitive: window.open('','_blank') creates an about:blank tab, then document.write(html) commits synchronously. In our test popup.content() sometimes returned blank because the framework captured the popup at open time. Not a bug — real browsers render correctly. If you want the assertion to be robust, consider navigating the popup to a data: URL instead: printWin.location.href = 'data:text/html;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(html) — this also gives the popup a title consistent with <title> tag.

Minor: report.tsx (456 lines) and expenses.tsx (454 lines) are approaching the 700-line guideline. The share sheet + PDF/CSV logic is nicely factored into src/utils/exportShare.ts (good DRY). Consider extracting the <ShareSheet/> component so both screens reuse the same JSX.

Minor: In webPrint (exportShare.ts:39), the popup is opened with 'noopener,noreferrer' which sets window.opener=null — the setTimeout(printWin.print, 400) still works because printWin reference is retained, but this is worth knowing if any future callback needs cross-window access.

Nice-to-have: rowsToCsv doesn't emit UTF-8 BOM. Excel on Windows may misrender ₹ / non-ASCII if user's locale isn't UTF-8. Consider prefixing '\uFEFF' when Platform.OS === 'web' to guarantee correct encoding.
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing TEST_Item expense and Aug 11 bill data on Glow Up tenant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is stable. If revisiting, note: (a) PDF popup uses window.open('') then document.write; Playwright popup.content() may read as blank due to about:blank timing — the popup opens is the reliable check via context.expect_page. Use page.expect_download for CSV. (b) react-native-calendars period marking is used; day cells expose role=button with the day number as inner text — use page.get_by_text('5', exact=True).first.click(force=True). (c) Custom range chip requires horizontal scroll into view since it's last in the ScrollView on mobile widths.
